notes.title: News 16/01/21
notes.notes:
Once again, thank you for all your suggestions about the game, thanks to them we were able to outline a new direction for our Early Access product. And thus today we can share some details about what can you expect from the next update of The Quantum Eye… 

The game will include a lot of puzzle. The storyline will be developed so that the players could have even more fun. Prepare yourself for countless adventures in the virtual world! Each stage will be a great workout for your brain cells. Of course, all this will be framed by excellent graphics. An additional advantage of the game will be a level editor so each player will be able to create their own puzzles and make a challenge to the gaming community and their friends.

Stay tuned for more information and updates!

Thanks! :)

notes.title: News 15/12/27
notes.notes:
Hello,

thank you for all of your reviews and opinions you share with us, we really appreciate it. We heard many kind words and also some criticism but every word we’ve listened to carefully and now it’s time to make a decision - how to develop our game? We are currently working on new features and we will present you the prototype of the new version of The Quantum Eye in a few weeks. We have many ideas and we would like you to help us choose which of them are the best and which ones we should implement for good. Expect something new! 

But until then, let’s all focus on celebrating Christmas and the New Year’s Eve :) Hope you are spending this magical time with your Families and Friends. Enjoy it and have a holly, jolly Christmas! ;)

Professor Why Team

notes.title: Update 15/12/09
notes.notes:
Hi!

We have published another update for our game. The most important things are:

- bug turning off he game's intro fixed

- system logging errors and warnings added (logs are available, if you have a problem with them, please send us the ZIPed content of your folder:
WIN: "C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\Professor Why\The Quantum Eye\" 
Linux: "/home/<username>/.config/unity3d/Professor Why/The Quantum Eye/" OSX: "/Users/<username>/Library/Application Support/Professor Why/The Quantum Eye/")

- optimization of lighting and shadows, settings of graphic shadows and vsync added

If you are facing any problems while playing Professor Why™: The Quantum Eye, please message us on Steam or via e-mail: contact@professor-why.com
